visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with wavy brown hair is seen in a dark indoor room, illuminated by soft warm light. He holds a glass bowl of pale-yellow ice cream and uses a metal spoon to scoop a portion, revealing a creamy texture. His facial expression is initially curious, then changes to wide-eyed amazement as he looks at the camera. (2) Close-up shots focus on a pint of Häagen-Dazs Macadamia Nut ice cream on a beige woven placemat. A spoon lifts a large chunk of ice cream, prominently displaying embedded macadamia nut pieces. The background shows another ice cream container and a glass bowl in soft focus, maintaining a cozy, domestic setting. (3) The man eats the ice cream, nodding vigorously with a wide smile and squinted eyes. He gestures towards the bowl while yellow text overlays appear at the bottom of the screen. The scene transitions between close-ups of the ice cream's texture and the man's exaggerated expressions of delight as he continues to taste the dessert. (4) A second man, wearing a grey baseball cap and a grey hoodie, appears in a brighter indoor room with bookshelves. He holds a Häagen-Dazs Cookies & Cream ice cream bar and bites into it. He holds the packaging next to his face while speaking, showing the chocolate coating and creamy interior of the bar. (5) The first man returns, now holding a small green cup of Pistachio & Cream ice cream. He takes a bite, closes his eyes in satisfaction, and then looks surprised. Suddenly, the screen cuts to black with large white and yellow text appearing in the center, ending the sequence on a humorous note.

The male speaker delivers a high-energy exclamation in Mandarin with a sharp pitch contour and rapid speech rate. A bright 'Ding' sound effect occurs simultaneously with a vocal emphasis. (2) The narration continues at a fast pace, describing food textures with clear articulation and high intensity. Percussive 'thud' and 'clink' sounds of a spoon hitting a bowl are audible. The BGM remains constant, maintaining a playful and energetic mood. Vocal arousal stays high, conveying excitement and satisfaction through exaggerated intonation. (3) A second male voice enters with a moderate speech rate and calmer tone. A distinct 'crunch' sound effect accompanies his speech, simulating the sound of biting into a chocolate-coated ice cream bar. The background music continues at a consistent volume, providing a steady rhythmic bed beneath the dialogue and environmental foley. The track ends abruptly with a sudden 'lights-out' swoosh SFX, followed by a confused vocal exclamation 'Hey!' and then complete silence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-energy promotion for Häagen-Dazs ice cream, specifically highlighting the sensory appeal of flavors like Macadamia Nut and Pistachio. By using exaggerated reactions, close-up texture shots, and comedic editing, it aims to drive appetite and brand awareness among a young, social-media-savvy audience.
